author: Techlore
description:
Attackers were taking over Instagram accounts by matching a target's region with a VPN, starting a password reset, and simply asking Meta's AI support chatbot to change the account's email...that was the entire attack. It ran in the wild since at least February, compromising thousands of accounts before high-profile victims (a Barack Obama White House account, the Space Force Chief Master Sergeant) made it impossible to ignore.

This is a clip from our Surveillance Report news podcast, Watch the complete episode here: https://youtu.be/xEz8mlRYWog

author: Techlore
description:
Bus Patrol installed AI cameras in tens of thousands of US school buses to catch drivers passing stopped buses, and now those cameras are being turned into automatic license plate readers that log every vehicle they drive past and feed the data to law enforcement. Leaked internal documents show the company knew the plan was controversial (including ICE concerns) but bet that the "protect the children" framing would keep people from pushing back.

This is a clip from our Surveillance Report news podcast, Watch the complete episode here: https://youtu.be/Pgo3N4WlMmc
